fact: The Harragi digital tax platform, built by a private firm at the initiative of the Pro-ARIDES programme with the Interior Ministry, was launched on 17 November 2024 in three pilot communes (Say, Douméga, Tsernaoua), where only some of its 39 configured taxes are collected through it and the rest still use paper tickets.
title: Mobilisation renforcée des ressources internes des communes au Niger
